turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How has the mobile SDK been to integrate?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The iOS SDK integrated in about a day, solid experience. The Android SDK, though, is noticeably behind — missing streaming playback support that the iOS one has had for months.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Has that Android gap affected your roadmap?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, we had to push our Android voice-assistant feature to next quarter specifically because of it.
